# TP Careers Malaysia & Thailand (English)

> Official English careers page of TP (formerly Teleperformance) Malaysia and Thailand, run by TP Talent Acquisition. Multilingual customer-experience roles in Penang, Kuala Lumpur, Petaling Jaya, Johor Bahru, Bangkok and work-from-home, with paid training, relocation, visa and medical support.

TP (formerly Teleperformance) is a global digital business services company across 100+ countries and 170+ languages. Legal entity in Malaysia: Teleperformance Malaysia Sdn Bhd, SSM 201601023769 (1194708-K). This page is an overview; conditions vary by project, region and regulations, and final conditions are confirmed in the offer letter and employment contract.

## Key facts

- Languages hired: Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Cantonese and English, with new lines opening regularly.
- Example roles: Mandarin support for a global tech brand; Japanese support for an e-commerce platform; Korean content review for a social platform; Thai tech support for a streaming service; Cantonese support for a fintech company; English customer support (entry level, trained from scratch).
- Experience: not required. Full paid training of 2 to 6 weeks before handling customers.
- Relocation: TP handles it end to end - Employment Pass, one-way flight, airport pickup and initial accommodation.
- Pay: competitive, with a language premium. The recruiter shares the range early; final terms are in the offer letter.
- Schedule: 8-hour shifts, 2 rest days per week.
- Career growth: structured promotions, mentorship, leadership academies and GoFluent language training.
- Cost of living: street food from RM5 (about US$1); rent RM800-1,500. 100+ nationalities on the team.
- Referrals: xRAF is open to anyone outside TP, up to RM3,000 per successful referral, paid via Touch 'n Go eWallet after the referral passes 90 days' probation.

## Offices

- One Precinct (OP), Penang: Lengkok Mayang Pasir 1, Bandar Bayan Baru, 11900 Bayan Lepas. Shuttle bus available.
- GBS @ Mahsuri, Penang: 1A Persiaran Mahsuri, Bayan Baru, 11900 Bayan Lepas. Walk-in interview venue.
- Livingston Tower (LV), Penang: 170 Jalan Argyll, 10050 George Town. UNESCO heritage zone.
- G-Tower (HQ), Kuala Lumpur: Level 11, 199 Jalan Tun Razak, 50400 Kuala Lumpur. KLCC district.
- Kelana Centre Point (KCP), Petaling Jaya: Level 3, Block D, Jalan SS 7/19, 47301 Petaling Jaya, Selangor.
- Johor Bahru: Mandarin and multilingual roles, interviews by appointment.
- Work from home: select roles fully remote anywhere in Malaysia, equipment provided, same benefits.
